difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that for data satisfying the first seven axioms the degree of the unit of the spectrum of the base field is one (statement lines 4993-4995). The proof (proof lines 4996-5010) uses that the cycle class of the base field is one and the multiplicativity of the degree map for products. H2: a complete short computation.
